meta.title: Text Mode Pixel Theme
meta.description: Restyles the Harness as a text-mode pixel-art terminal: phosphor and paper palettes, monospace type, square tiles, pixel scrollbars, and a live ASCII wallpaper that drifts behind the UI — a koi pond in dark mode, a honu lagoon in light mode. The Pixel theme page in the sidebar switches scenes or turns the skin off.
